cookies_description: The one cookie elliotleelewis.com’s host may set, and what the game remembers.
cookies_intro: This site doesn’t set any cookies of its own, and nothing on it tracks you. The only cookie you might get comes from Cloudflare, which hosts the site, and only to keep it secure.
cookies_cloudflare_body: When Cloudflare’s bot protection can’t tell whether a visit comes from a person, it asks your browser to pass a quick check. This cookie remembers that you passed, so you aren’t checked again on every page.
cookies_set_by_value: Cloudflare, only if you’re asked to pass a check
cookies_purpose_value: Security: telling people from bots. It isn’t used to identify or follow you.
cookies_kept_for_value: As long as the check lasts, 30 minutes by default
cookies_cloudflare_more: Read more in Cloudflare’s own list of its cookies
cookies_game_body: The game keeps your best score and the easter eggs you’ve found in your browser’s local storage, so they’re still there next time you play. They never leave your device, and clearing your browser’s data for this site removes them.
cookies_analytics_body: I count visits with Cloudflare Web Analytics, which sets no cookies, stores nothing on your device and doesn’t fingerprint you.
